plugins.description: jev-ultrafast 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件实现，在dhs对话中用自然语言驱动真实浏览器，利用jev模型实现浏览器操控。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-jev-ultrafast

[English](README-en.md) | 中文 | [Español](README-es.md) | [Português](README-pt.md) | [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast?style=flat)](LICENSE)
[![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast?label=version&style=flat)](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast/tags)
[![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast?label=%E2%98%85&style=flat)](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast/stargazers)
![dsh plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-000000?style=flat)

> jev-ultrafast 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件实现，在dhs对话中用自然语言驱动真实浏览器，利用jev模型实现浏览器操控。

## 这是什么

它给 DeepSeek Harness（下称 DSH）补一条能力：**用一句自然语言目标驱动浏览器办事**。

常规做法是模型看页面、想一步、点一下。每个点击占一轮对话。这里换了分工：页面先压成一张**带编号的控件表**（下称**元素表**）。一次请求同时定「做什么操作」和「对哪个元素」。主模型只在开头出目标、结尾读结果。所以一趟多步任务只花一次工具调用。

它是插件（bundle），不是技能。它注册两个工具和一条斜杠命令：

| 入口 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| 工具 `jev_browser_task` | 按一句话目标办事。可以带 `expect` 核验。跑完带回结果和最终页面的文字 |
| 工具 `jev_browser_read` | 一屏一屏读长页面，去重后拼回整篇。不花决策请求 |
| 命令 `/jev-ultrafast` | 在输入框里直接说要做什么。不必让主模型参与 |

## 上游来源

**这是一个移植项目，不是原创。** 上游是 [jev-ultrafast](https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast)（MIT，© 2026 Browser Use）。上游是 Python 实现，约 690 行。本项目把它改写成 TypeScript，并打包成 DSH 插件。本项目自己的仓库在 [xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast](https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast)。

**它不是官方出品。** 本项目与 Browser Use、TypeSafe 没有隶属、背书或赞助关系。「Browser Use」「TypeSafe」「Jev」是各自所有者的商标。这里提到它们，只为了说明来源，以及说清插件在调用谁的接口。

从上游搬来的东西，逐件列在 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。要点如下：

| 上游文件 | 本项目文件 | 搬了什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `jev_ultrafast/snapshot.js` | `src/browser/snapshot.js` | 页面内的快照脚本，近乎原样 |
| `jev_ultrafast/questions.py` | `src/prompts.ts` | 决策用的提示词，近乎原样 |
| `jev_ultrafast/model.py` | `src/decision/*` | 元素表、一次请求定操作与目标、答案校验 |
| `jev_ultrafast/agent.py` | `src/loop.ts` | 主循环、过期决策的处理、文本值缓存 |
| `jev_ultrafast/browser.py` | `src/browser/*` | 新鲜度守卫、动作前的可见性与几何检查 |

上游依赖 `browser-harness`。它管浏览器连接、守护进程和权限弹窗。TypeScript 里没有对等物。本项目照 Chrome DevTools Protocol 重写了这一段。

## 需要先准备什么

1. **一个 DSH**：网页端（`dsh web`）或桌面端应用，任一都行。插件对两端都支持，装在你正在用的那一端。要求是 `0.2.0-rc.1` 一代（插件的依赖声明覆盖 `0.1.7-rc.2` 到 `0.3.0` 之前）。
2. **一个浏览器**：Edge 或 Chrome。
3. **密钥**（按你选的路）：决策服务的密钥，以及文本模型的密钥。插件不内置密钥，调用时从 DSH 凭据库读你自己的。

## 安装

网页端：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jev-ultrafast
```

装完重启一次 DSH。

桌面端：

在左侧导航栏点**插件**进入插件页面，再点**添加插件**；在输入框里填 `dsh-jev-ultrafast`（或本项目的仓库地址、本机目录路径），然后点**安装**。对话框里的「安装源」默认是 **npm 官方源**，国内网络慢可以换「中国大陆镜像源」。装好后按提示启用，再**重启一次应用**。

## 怎么用

在输入框里直接用自然语言说要做什么：

“用浏览器打开 https://www.example.com 该网页读取内容”

“用jev浏览器搜索美剧《人生复本》”

“调用插件dsh-jev-ultrafast打开这个页面 https://www.example.com ”

或

- `/jev-ultrafast https://www.example.com 找到价格并说明是多少` —— 句子里有网址。开跑前不调用任何模型。
- `/jev-ultrafast 查一下明天北京的天气` —— 句子里没有网址。若句子里点名了站点，本地就认出来。认得的站点有 13 个：百度、必应、谷歌、知乎、微博、豆瓣、淘宝天猫、京东、小红书、抖音、B 站、维基、GitHub。认不出才问一次文本模型。问不出就从搜索引擎开始，默认用必应。


## 配置

设置页在**设置 → Jev 浏览器**。

### 两扇门

| 门 | 两条路 | 密钥 |
|---|---|---|
| 决策服务 | TypeSafe 官方直连；或 OpenRouter 的决策通道 | 从 DSH 凭据库读。插件不另存 |
| 文本模型 | 七个预设供应商；或 `dsh:<供应商 id>`（DSH 里已配好的模型） | 预设那条路用自己的密钥；DSH 内置那条路由 DSH 自己管 |

### 浏览器：两种连接方式

**你正在用的浏览器**（默认）。它直接用你现在的登录状态。第一次要这样做：

1. 在这个浏览器的地址栏里打开 `edge://inspect/#remote-debugging`（Chrome 用 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`）。
2. 勾上「允许远程调试」。
3. 出现「允许远程调试？」的框时，点「允许」。也可以先在设置页按「连接你的浏览器」，把连接握在手里。

勾过这一次之后，开着关着都能用。关着的时候，插件会替你打开它——一个参数都不传，跟你双击图标等价（2026-10-03 起，「绝不启动你日常档案」那条红线按用户裁决移除）。它自己的调试口会随身带上。

**每个浏览器会话只允许一次。** 连上后插件一直握着这条连接。跑任务、读页面、开新标签都不再弹框。浏览器整个关掉重开，才算新会话，会再问一次。

**插件自己的浏览器**。它另开一份数据目录，与你日常那份互不干扰。需要登录的站点，在那个窗口里登录一次，之后一直保留。

选「你正在用的浏览器」时，那一块还有两件事可做：

- **看看能带走多少登录**：只数一数日常浏览器里有多少 cookie、分布在哪些域名。数完立刻断开，不写任何东西。
- **把登录灌进插件自己的浏览器**：把 cookie 写进去，写完逐站核对。它走调试通道读写，不碰档案文件。

## 开发与验证

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck   # 类型检查
pnpm test        # 单元测试
pnpm build       # 构建 lib/
pnpm pack        # 打出 tgz
```

真浏览器集成测试默认跳过。要跑就加环境变量：

```sh
JEV_BROWSER=1 pnpm test
```

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。上游版权与第三方说明见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit reasoning effort levels and thinking formats for models that declare none.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reasoning-setup

DeepSeek Harness 的思考强度配置页：一个 out-of-tree profile bundle（插件）。它扫描已注册的 Provider 与模型，找出**没有声明思考能力**的模型（这类模型在任何模型选择器里都不会出现「思考强度」一行），并提供一个设置页，直接为自定义 Provider 的模型声明 `reasoningEfforts` 与 `thinkingFormat`——写入的正是 `llm-pi-ai` 插件的那个设置文档（与「模型」设置页、dsh-zhipu-plan 写的是同一份）。

## 为什么需要它

dsh 中思考强度是每个模型的**声明式能力**，不是全局开关：只有当 provider/model 路由解析出的模型元数据带 `reasoning` 档位表时，选择器才会出现「思考强度」（见 harness `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` 的 `resolveModelReasoning`）。手工在 `models:` 列表里声明的模型默认按非推理模型处理，必须逐模型声明 `reasoningEfforts`。手改 YAML 容易拼错档位名和 wire 值；本插件把这件事变成页面上的勾选与填写，并在写入前按 pi-ai 解析器的同套规则校验。

## 页面能做什么

- **扫描**：列出全部已注册 Provider 及其模型，标记每个模型当前是否提供思考档位、提供哪些档、默认档是什么。不可经 llm-pi-ai 设置文档编辑的 Provider（如 deepseek-official）只读展示。
- **声明/修改**：为可编辑模型勾选要提供的档位（off / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max），逐档填写 wire 发送值（即请求里发给网关的字符串；`off` 可留空＝选择该档时不发送思考参数），可选 `thinkingFormat`（openai / deepseek / qwen / zai 等 11 种）。
- **移除声明**：删掉本页写入的声明，让模型回到目录继承/默认行为。
- 写入带 revision 乐观锁；文档在扫描后被其它页面改动会拒绝写入（`reasoning-setup/conflict`）而不是覆盖。

## 写到哪里

- 路由带 `models:` 列表（自定义 provider 的常见形态）→ `providers.<route>.models.<i>.reasoningEfforts`（及同条目的 `compat.thinkingFormat`）。
- 目录路由（如 zai / zai-coding-cn）→ `providers.<route>.modelOverrides.<model>.reasoningEfforts`。

保存后重新打开模型选择器即可看到「思考强度」一行。

## 安装

需要 0.1.7-rc.2 及以上、实测 0.2.0-rc.1 的安装（dsh-base 挂载 llm/settings/Typert seam）。

- **插件市场一键安装**：在 dsh 的插件市场（dshmarket）中搜索 `dsh-reasoning-setup`，点击安装并重启。市场条目指向下面那个已含构建产物的 tarball，安装时不需要本地工具链。
- **预构建 tarball**（离线/手动安装）：[dsh-reasoning-setup.tgz](https://github.com/Ayelsh/reasoning-setup/releases/latest/download/dsh-reasoning-setup.tgz)，在应用内 **设置 → 插件** 里选择该文件安装并重启。该地址始终指向最新 release，里面的 `lib/` 已构建好。
- **源码安装**：

  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Ayelsh/reasoning-setup
  ```

  构建产物 `lib/` 已随仓库提交（见 `.gitignore` 注释），因此源码安装不需要本地构建工具链，也不用 `prepare` 在安装时跑 esbuild。
- **profile bundle 方式**：把 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `dsh-reasoning-setup`（`lib/` 已随包提供）。

插件本身不声明运行时依赖，运行时通过 profile 的模块回退链接复用宿主已加载的 harness 包。

## 布局

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `src/host/` | `reasoningSetup` 服务：`scan()` 连接 LLM runtime 的 provider/model 枚举与 llm-pi-ai 设置文档；`apply()` 校验草稿后经 `ctx.settings.mutate` 写入。`scan.ts` 是纯函数（表读取、声明定位、校验镜像、op 构建）。 |
| `src/wire/` | 两个 Typert 面，按生成器输出形状手写（仓库生成器需要 workspace 的 ts.Program，out-of-tree 包没有）。`typert-host.js` 是 loader 从 `./typert` 导出注册的清单；`typert-remote-client.js` 是浏览器侧经 `ctx.remote.$mount` 挂载的贡献。 |
| `src/client/` | 设置页浏览器半边：注册 `settings.section` 插槽、双语字典、自注入样式表。界面是 Liquid Glass 材质：环境光场 + 浮起工具栏 + 每个 Provider 一张玻璃卡，行内不再叠玻璃。 |
| `scripts/` | `build.mjs`（esbuild 三产物 + 自检）、`verify.mjs`（对照 harness 校验：导入解析、loader 清单校验、档位/格式词表与 `llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` 的门表比对、scan 规则夹具）、`client-smoke.mjs`（stub shell 物化浏览器包）、`preview.mjs` / `preview-shots.mjs`（截图夹具，见下）。 |

## 截图夹具

材质的判断只能靠看渲染结果，所以仓库里带了一套可复跑的夹具：它把真实组件挂进 jsdom，按设置面板的真实几何（800px 面板、188px 导航、`.options` 滚动列，顶部零内边距）输出独立 HTML，再用 Chromium 逐场景截图。

```sh
pnpm run preview                                   # 写 preview/*.html（明暗两套 + 忙碌背景）
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright pnpm run preview:shots   # 写 preview/shots/*.png
```

场景覆盖 ready / loading / error / empty / editor / filtered / notice / press，以及滚动后的吸顶、忙碌背景、`prefers-reduced-transparency`、`prefers-contrast`、`prefers-reduced-motion` 三种偏好极值，全部明暗各一张。`preview/` 是生成物，不入库；改材质后重跑这两条命令并逐张看。

## 构建

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build      # 写 lib/index.js, lib/typert.js, lib/client.js
pnpm run verify     # build + 对照 deepseek-harness 检验 + 浏览器冒烟
```

构建产物 `lib/`（`index.js`、`typert.js`、`client.js`）是提交进仓库的：`github:` 源码安装直接打包仓库内容，所以改动源码后请重跑 `pnpm run build` 并一并提交 `lib/`。`prepack` 与 `build` 相同，只用于 `pnpm pack` / 发布前刷新产物，安装时不会执行。

host 半边导入 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（类型另有 `dsh-llm`、`dsh-llm-pi-ai`），全部在宿主应用的依赖闭包里，模块回退链接会解析到运行进程已加载的副本。

## 已知边界

- 只能编辑经 `llm-pi-ai` 设置文档配置的路由；其它适配器（如 deepseek-official）的模型只读展示。
- 「移除声明」只移除本页写入的 `reasoningEfforts` / `compat.thinkingFormat`，不会把目录模型改成 `reasoningEfforts: false`（剥离目录声明的思考能力不属于本页的编辑动作）。
- 档位与格式词表镜像自 `dsh-llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`（该包未导出）；`pnpm run verify` 与 harness 源码比对，升级 harness 后请重跑。

## 许可证

本项目以 MIT 许可证发布，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

档位词表与校验规则镜像自 [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek）的 `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`，归属声明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

本项目与 DeepSeek 无从属、背书或赞助关系。「DeepSeek」为其各自所有者的商标，此处仅为描述性使用。

plugins.description: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Currently: dsh-model-fold, collapsible provider groups in the composer model picker.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

Plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

## Plugins

| Plugin | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`dsh-model-fold`](packages/dsh-model-fold) | 把模型选择器按供应商折叠起来 —— 每个供应商只占一行，点名称才展开它的模型。 |
| [`dsh-commandcode-quota`](packages/dsh-commandcode-quota) | Command Code 套餐额度面板（[上游](https://github.com/Jovan1666/commandcode-usage)的**最小化 UI 改进版**）—— 默认折叠成小芯片，点击展开。 |
| [`dsh-task-notify`](packages/dsh-task-notify) | 回合完成提醒 —— 一声轻提示音 + 右下角完成卡片（点击回到该会话）+ 可选 Windows 系统通知。 |

## Install

Each plugin is a DSH profile bundle that declares its own `dsh.bundle.patch`, so
one command installs and mounts it — no hand-editing of `cordis.patch.yml`.

```sh
# 模型选择器折叠
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LimiChan-2026/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-model-fold

# Command Code 额度面板（最小化 UI 版）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LimiChan-2026/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-commandcode-quota

# 回合完成提醒（提示音 + 右下角卡片 + 系统通知）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LimiChan-2026/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-task-notify
```

Swap `desktop` for another profile name (`web`, …) if you are not using the
desktop app.

Then **fully quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness**, and reload the page. The client
bundle is loaded into the browser when the host starts, so a newly installed
plugin does not appear until then.

> `dsh` is not always on `PATH`. The Windows desktop app ships it at
> `<install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-fold
```

Then quit and reopen.

## Layout

```
packages/
  dsh-model-fold/          one plugin per directory
    index.js               host half
    client.js              browser half
    cordis.patch.yml       dsh.bundle.patch layer
    package.json           declares dsh.bundle + dsh.client
    test/                  jsdom behaviour tests
```

## Notes on the git install form

`github:<owner>/<repo>#path:/<subdir>` is what makes a monorepo work: pnpm clones
the repository and installs the package from that subdirectory. The `path:` must
point at the directory holding the plugin's `package.json`.

These plugins deliberately carry **no `scripts`, no `dependencies`, and no
`peerDependencies`**. That keeps the git install frictionless:

- No `prepare`/`build` script, so pnpm's build-script gate never blocks the
  install (a git-hosted plugin that builds on install needs its key added under
  `allowBuilds` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` first).
- No DSH peer range, so no version-compatibility exemption is required.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把会话日志与插件环境备份到任意 WebDAV 服务，并可从 WebDAV 恢复（会话+环境双源同步、rev/generation 版本机制、三方比较与冲突策略）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-webdav-sync

把 DSH 的**会话日志**和**插件环境**同步到任意 WebDAV 服务，带版本号 / 时间 / 设备溯源，可增量备份与恢复。零运行时依赖（Node 内置 `zstd` + `fetch`），host + 客户端两半齐全，Desktop 与 CLI 都能用。

> 仓库内的参考实现（v0.2.2），已在真实 `dsh` 0.2.0-rc.1 的 web profile 上跑通双源同步、版本溯源、冲突处理与强制恢复。

## 它同步什么

| 源 | 内容 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **会话** | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/**/*.jsonl.zstd` | 字节级；恢复时按日志头部的 `cwd` 重算落位目录 |
| **插件环境** | profile 的 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`pnpm-workspace.yaml`、`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`（可选）、插件市场状态（可选） | 这些才是"环境真身"；`node_modules` 是可重装的产物，**永不同步** |
| **插件清单** | 自动生成的 `environment/inventory.json` | 每个插件的**名称 + 版本 + 启用状态**——宿主自带的清单 API 不含版本号，所以版本是插件自己从 `node_modules` 里读的 |

## 版本机制：怎么知道哪一份是最新的

远端 `manifest.json` 是 v2 结构，每个文件都带三层信息：

```json
{
  "schema": 2,
  "generation": 12,                      // 整份备份的代号，有变化才 +1
  "updatedAt": "2026-09-30T10:12:54.873Z",
  "device": { "id": "dev-98597ad2", "label": "sandbox-mac", "platform": "darwin" },
  "devices": { "dev-98597ad2": { "label": "sandbox-mac", "lastSeen": "..." } },
  "entries": {
    "sessions/--Users-me-proj--/sess-x/session.v4.jsonl.zstd": {
      "sha1": "…", "size": 12933,
      "rev": 3,                            // 逻辑版本号：内容变了才 +1
      "updatedAt": "2026-09-30T09:02:08.000Z",  // 源文件时间
      "device": "dev-98597ad2"             // 最后写入者
    }
  }
}
```

判定规则（`lib/versioning.js`）：

1. `sha1` 相同 → 一致，什么都不做；
2. 本机存有 `base`（上次同步的共同祖先）时：只有一端变了 → 直接推进那一端，**不是冲突**；
3. 两端相对 base 都变了 → **冲突**，按 `conflictPolicy` 取舍：
   - `prefer-newer`（默认）：先比 `rev`，再比 `updatedAt`，最后用 `device` 字典序收敛（保证两端算出同一结果，不会来回覆盖）；
   - `keep-local` / `keep-remote` / `keep-both` / `manual`；
4. 落败的一方默认另存为 `.conflict-<设备>-r<版本>` 副本，**绝不静默丢弃**。

## 安全红线

- push / pull **都不删除本机会话**；
- 恢复覆盖的条件是"本机相对 base 没改过"（覆盖不丢东西）；本机改过的文件必须显式开启 `pullOverwrite` 或走「以云端为准」（`POST /pull?force=1`）；
- 环境文件被覆盖前先写 `.bak-<时间戳>`；
- 运行中的会话不参与覆盖；
- **同步两侧都剥离本插件自身的配置行**：否则换机恢复后会把 WebDAV 同步目标改回旧机器；恢复时本机那一行会被保留（换机后你重新填的地址不会被云端旧值抹掉）；
- 永不触碰 `node_modules`。

## 配置界面（已实测渲染）

**设置 → WebDAV 同步**，三组表单（连接 / 同步内容 / 版本与冲突）+ 状态面板：

```
连接      可达
本机      sandbox-mac
云端      第 2 代，2026/9/30 18:13:39 由 sandbox-mac 写入，10 个文件
差异      待上传 0，待恢复 0，冲突 0，一致 10
插件清单对照：一致
```

按钮：保存 / 状态/版本 / 测试连接 / 预演 / 立即备份 / 从云端恢复 / 以云端为准 / 安装依赖。

本插件**不注册斜杠命令**，因此会话窗口的 `+` / `/` 菜单里不会出现 `webdav-sync` 入口（DSH 会自动列出所有已注册的宿主命令，注册即曝光）。界面之外要用，走下面的同源 HTTP 路由或 `curl`。

## 环境恢复后的最后一步

恢复 `package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` 之后需要重装依赖：

- 界面上点「安装依赖」（等价于 `POST /webdav-sync/install`）；
- 它调用 `ctx.profileContext.packageManager`（打包版用内置 pnpm、开发版用 PATH 里的 pnpm），在 profile 目录里执行 `install`；
- 等价手工命令：`cd $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile> && pnpm install`。

## 测试

```bash
pnpm install   # 只为 @deepseek-ai/schemastery
node --test test/*.test.mjs
```

43 个用例：版本排序与三方比较矩阵、WebDAV 客户端路径与建目录（含 basePath 非空）、全新 state 面对已有云端的 base 落下、`nextRev`、v1 清单兼容、环境发现与清单版本、自指剥离、冲突各策略、双源端到端、force 恢复、恢复后收敛性（不抖动）、运行中会话跳过、鉴权失败。

## 目录结构

```
lib/index.js       入口：name/inject/Config/apply；接 profileContext、路由、定时器、依赖安装
lib/config.js      schemastery Config（.volatile() 子树决定哪些字段可被设置页写回）+ 到引擎配置的映射
lib/versioning.js  版本机制核心：compareVersion / decide（三方比较）/ nextRev / manifest v1→v2 归一化
lib/state.js       本机状态：设备 ID、base 三方基准、sha1 缓存
lib/env.js         环境采集：声明文件发现、插件清单（含版本）、patch 解析与自指剥离、清单 diff
lib/layout.js      复刻宿主的 encodeSegment / projectKey / 日志识别 / 流式读 header
lib/webdav.js      零依赖 WebDAV 客户端（Basic / MKCOL / PUT / GET / PROPFIND / DELETE）
lib/sync.js        同步引擎：双源、manifest v2、冲突副本、原子写、force 恢复
lib/routes.js      同源 HTTP 路由（首行过 ctx.connection.requestRejection 信任栅栏）
client/bundle.js   浏览器半边：window.__ModuleLoader__ 自注册 + settings.section 表单
test/              43 个用例
```

## 安装

```bash
# 已发布到 npm 后（CLI 的 web / 自定义 profile）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-webdav-sync

# 直接从 GitHub 源码装（pnpm 的 git 协议，会按本地源码构建/链接）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alfredhuang211/dsh-webdav-sync
```

**Desktop**：`desktop` profile 由 Electron 托管，CLI 拒绝操作，必须走 App 内的插件市场。`package.json` 已按市场契约声明 `engines.dsh` 与 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer。

## 仓库

源码：<https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-webdav-sync>（MIT）

开发指引与踩坑记录另见上层文档《DSH插件开发指南-WebDAV会话同步.md》，本仓库只放插件本身。

plugins.description: Command Code balance and quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as a status row under the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-commandcode-quota

A **Command Code balance and quota panel** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

The plugin renders a compact status row directly underneath the DSH composer:

- **5-hour, weekly and monthly usage windows** as live percentages
- **Available balance**
- Click the row to expand the full breakdown: used / limit / remaining / reset time, total spend, tokens, success rate, subscription and account information

It is **single-account by design**. There is no account switcher, and your API key never reaches the browser.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web client (`dsh web` or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20 or newer
- A Command Code API key

## Install

### From npm (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-commandcode-quota
```

DSH expands the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` into your profile, so no manual patch editing is needed.

### From a local checkout

```bash
dsh plugin add file:/path/to/dsh-commandcode-quota
```

### Manual junction (desktop app)

The Electron desktop profile is managed by the application and does not run the `dsh plugin add` reconciliation, so register it yourself.

Link the package into the shared resolution pool:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\dsh-commandcode-quota" `
  -Target "C:\path\to\dsh-commandcode-quota"
```

Then add this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-commandcode-quota
      name: 'dsh-commandcode-quota'
      config:
        apiKeyEnv: COMMANDCODE_API_KEY
```

> The junction name must be exactly the package name, otherwise the host cannot resolve the import.

After installing or changing the plugin, reload the plugin tree (the plugin page's refresh action, or a client restart).

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` | Credential entry resolved through DSH's credentials service |
| `fallbackEnv` | — | Optional second entry, used only when the first one is missing |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.commandcode.ai` | Command Code API origin |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request timeout in milliseconds |

Credentials live in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, or in DSH Settings → Credentials. Never commit them.

## How it works

The package has two halves:

- **Host half** (`src/index.js`) resolves the key through the DSH credentials service and registers a read-only HTTP endpoint that fans out to the Command Code API, then aggregates the responses into a single payload. The key is read on every request and never serialized to the client.
- **Client half** (`src/client.js`) registers a status row into the composer dock slot, polls the host endpoint, and renders it with DSH theme tokens so light and dark themes both work.

Data comes from four Command Code endpoints, each called with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`:

| Endpoint | Used for |
|---|---|
| `GET /alpha/billing/credits` | Balance and the 5-hour / weekly limits |
| `GET /alpha/usage/summary` | Spend, tokens and success rate |
| `GET /alpha/billing/subscriptions` | Subscription status and period boundaries |
| `GET /alpha/whoami` | Account information |

The monthly window is composed from the usage total plus the remaining credits, with the reset time taken from the subscription period.

### Behaviour under failure

- The four requests run in parallel, so total latency is the slowest one rather than the sum.
- A connection-level failure is retried once; a deliberate timeout is not retried.
- On failure the panel falls back to the last successful value (kept in-process for 6 hours) and reports it as stale.
- An HTTP 401 is never masked by cached data, because it means the credential itself is wrong.

## Development

```bash
npm test                        # host and client unit tests; no network, no DSH process
node --check src/index.js       # host half syntax
node --check src/client.js      # client half syntax
```

The tests stub the credentials service, the web server, `fetch` and React, so they run offline and never touch a live DSH instance.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Cut model-facing tokens out of tool output before it enters a request. A global DeepSeek Harness plugin: lossless normalization, annotated repetition collapse, and recoverable structure-aware trimming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-diet

A global DeepSeek Harness plugin that removes tokens from tool output **before**
that output can enter a model request — without removing anything the model may
need, and without changing what the model is able to do.

```
tests/t0.py::case PASSED
tests/t1.py::case PASSED
…
[... 12235 of 12416 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 4 diagnostic lines
 retained, middle elided ...]
______________________ test_charge_card_rejects_expired _______________________
src/payments/charge.py:118: in charge_card
E   CardExpiredError: card expired 2024-01-31
FAILED tests/test_payments.py::test_charge_card_rejects_expired
[…]
…899 tests collected…
(Trimmed 12235 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/session-…/bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path.)
```

## The problem it solves

Every tool result becomes part of the conversation the moment it is logged, and
from then on the model re-reads it on every step of the session. The shipped
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` only trims **once a compaction trigger
qualifies**, and rewriting a result that late invalidates the prompt-cache prefix
that was already established — so trimming late costs extra as well as saving.

`dsh-context-diet` runs at `tools/post-execute`, the last waterfall before the
registry freezes a result into a `tool/result` event. A rewrite there belongs to
the call it came from: there is no cache prefix to invalidate, no second copy to
reconcile, and no durable edit to replay.

## What it removes

### 1. Lossless normalization (on by default)

Reduces output to what a terminal would actually display. A terminal shows no
glyph for an escape sequence, so removing one cannot change meaning.

| Transform | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escape sequences | `\e[31merror\e[0m` | `error` |
| OSC hyperlinks and titles | `\e]8;;http://x\a link` | `link` |
| Carriage-return overlays | `10%\r50%\r100%` | `100%` |
| Backspace erasure | `ab\bc` | `ac` |
| Trailing whitespace | `a   \n` | `a\n` |
| Blank-line padding | `a\n\n\n\n\nb` | `a\n\nb` |

### 2. Annotated compaction (on by default)

A run of at least `repeatThreshold` (8) byte-identical consecutive lines that is
also at least `repeatMinRunChars` (1000) characters long becomes one line naming
the exact repeat count:

```
npm warn deprecated inflight@1.0.6: This module is not supported…  [x400 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

The run is collapsed **only when the annotation is strictly shorter than the run
it replaces**, so this pass can never enlarge a result. The count is preserved, so
the run is exactly reconstructible from the annotation and nothing is dropped
silently — which is why this pass needs no recovery file.

### 3. Recoverable, structure-aware trimming (on by default above 32,000 characters)

A result still larger than `maxInlineChars` is replaced by:

1. its head (`headChars`),
2. an omission marker stating exactly how much was dropped,
3. **the diagnostically significant lines from the omitted middle** — errors,
   failures, exceptions, assertions, stack frames, diff hunks and headers, and
   `file:line:col` references (`significantChars`), and
4. its tail (`tailChars`),

followed by a notice naming a spill file that holds the complete normalized text,
with the backend's own retrieval guidance.

Blind head/tail cutting discards the middle unconditionally. Keeping the
diagnostic lines makes the same budget **strictly more informative**, not less —
measured on a 900-test `pytest -v` run, every one of `CardExpiredError`,
`charge.py:118`, `test_charge_card_rejects_expired`, and `1 failed, 899 passed`
survives with this plugin and is lost by a head/tail cut of the same size.

## Why quality is not affected

- **Nothing is dropped without a record.** Every removal is either a
  control character a terminal never displays, or something that is counted,
  annotated, and written verbatim to a spill file the notice tells the model how
  to read.
- **`read` is exempt by default.** File-content output is line-addressed: blank-line
  or trailing-whitespace rewriting would corrupt content a model may quote back
  at an editor. This matches the shipped `dsh-spill-policy`, which exempts `read`
  for the same reason.
- **The default budget is conservative.** No result under 32,000 characters —
  roughly 8,000 tokens — is touched at all, except by the lossless passes.
- **It cannot alter capability.** It registers no tools, removes none, changes no
  prompts, and changes no model or reasoning settings. Tool schemas, the system
  prompt, and the tool catalog are byte-identical to a run without it, so the
  prompt cache behaves exactly as before.
- **It never makes a model call and never adds a request.**
- **It fails open.** Any unexpected shape, missing service, or thrown error
  returns the incoming result untouched and logs a warning. `verify.mjs` covers
  each of those paths.

## Measured effect

On a synthetic but realistic bash-heavy corpus (900-test `pytest -v`, `npm install`
with 400 repeated deprecation warnings, 2,400-line `cargo build`, a `curl`
progress bar, and a 3,000-entry `find`), with shipped defaults:

| Result | Before | Model sees | Removed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `pytest -v`, buried failure | 48,002 | 12,555 | 74% |
| `npm install`, 400 repeats | 33,711 | 236 | 99% |
| `cargo build`, buried error | 158,997 | 20,218 | 87% |
| `curl` progress bar | 4,572 | 61 | 99% |
| `find` over a large tree | 130,890 | 12,218 | 91% |
| **Total** | **376,172** | **45,288** | **88%** |

The lossless tier alone accounts for 15% of that; the rest is annotated
compaction and recoverable trimming. Character counts are not billed tokens —
the figures are indicative, and `/diet` reports the real numbers for the session
you are in.

### Verified against a running Harness

Both passes were exercised live, through the real `tools/post-execute` waterfall
of a running `dsh web` profile, using the real `dsh-spill-local` backend:

```text
$ for i in $(seq 1 30); do echo "SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING"; done
SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING  [x30 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

```text
$ awk '… 570 lines with an error at line 285 …'
download asset 0000 of 0570 ================================================
…
[... 31890 of 43967 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 1 diagnostic lines retained, middle elided ...]

src/engine/pipeline.rs:204:7 - error TS2345: UNIQUE_BURIED_DIAGNOSTIC_MARKER

[...]
…
download asset 0569 of 0570 ================================================

(Trimmed 31890 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/c1cbcd405966-bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path to search within it.)
```

The 43,967-character result reached the model as 12,077 characters (72% smaller),
the diagnostic line that a head/tail cut would have dropped was retained, and the
recovery file was verified to hold all 571 lines of the original output.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-context-diet
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-context-diet → on**.
   An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.

The bundle inserts one global Host row, so it applies to every session in the
profile — not to a single session. It needs no credentials and no other plugin;
the `tools/post-execute` seam is part of `dsh-tools`, and the spill backend comes
from `dsh-spill-local`, both of which the shipped compositions provide. Without a
spill backend the plugin still normalizes and compacts, and simply declines to
trim, because trimming without a recovery file would lose information.

## Configuration

Every field is optional; omitting it keeps the shipped default. Override any of
them in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is applied after bundle
layers and therefore survives plugin upgrades:

```yaml
- id: context-diet
  name: 'dsh-context-diet'
  config:
    maxInlineChars: 64000     # 0 keeps only the lossless and annotated passes
    exemptTools: ['read', 'read_image']
    repeatTh

plugins.description: Session cost and remaining provider balance below the DeepSeek Harness Web composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-meter

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows one ambient line below the Web composer:
the estimated model cost of the current session **and of every subagent session
it started**, plus the remaining balance of the provider route in use.

```
[ Composer card                                 ]
      Cost $0.1306 · Balance $12.50
```

Hovering a pill shows its breakdown: token buckets per model route, how much of
the total came from subagent sessions, per-request fees, and topped-up versus
granted credit for the balance.

## What the number includes

- **This session**, priced from the usage the provider reported in its own log.
- **Every subagent session it delegated to**, transitively. A subagent runs as a
  separate Session with its own log, so the parent's log names its children
  (`subagent/catalog`) but never their usage; the plugin reads each child's own
  projected cost instead — from the live Session while the app still holds it,
  from the child's durable checkpoint once it has settled, and by re-folding that
  child's own log where no checkpoint can serve it (see below).
- **Per-request fees** for calls that are billed outside token usage, currently
  DeepSeek Search/Fetch requests at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests. A
  request event records the request, not its usage, so this is a stated estimate.

If a child session cannot be read at all — no live Session and no checkpoint
whose lifecycle matches — the plugin does not pretend it cost nothing. It marks
the total as a lower bound (`at least $0.1306`) and says how many sessions were
unreadable, rather than showing a number that looks exact.

Why a total can still differ from <https://platform.deepseek.com>'s usage log:
that page bills an account, so it also covers sessions this machine never ran and
any other client using the same key. Auxiliary model calls whose usage is never
recorded (session titles, and the DeepSeek-side search calls a search request can
fan out to, up to `maxUses` per request) are billed by DeepSeek but are invisible
to any log-based reader. The plugin therefore estimates from what the logs
record, and labels that estimate as one.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web app (`dsh web`). The balance read needs the
  `connection` and `credentials` services, which the shipped Web composition
  provides.
- For the balance pill, a wallet endpoint plus a stored credential for it; the
  built-in default is DeepSeek's Platform balance endpoint with a
  `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference. Cost needs nothing: prices ship in the
  row config.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dsh-plugin-db/dsh-cost-meter

# …or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-cost-meter
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-cost-meter → on**.
   (An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.)

The package ships a bundle patch, so enabling it inserts the row with built-in
defaults. Cost works immediately; the balance pill appears once a wallet source
answers. The credential reference is resolved on the Host, so the secret never
reaches the browser.

## Configuration

Every value lives in the row config, so it survives DSH upgrades in the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (highest-priority layer):

```yaml
- id: dsh-cost-meter
  name: 'dsh-cost-meter'
  config:
    prices:
      - provider: '*'        # '*' matches any route; a literal provider wins over '*'
        model: deepseek-flash
        currency: USD
        input: 0.3           # per 1M cache-miss input tokens
        output: 1.2          # per 1M output tokens
        cacheRead: 0.006     # per 1M cache-hit input tokens
        cacheWrite: 0.3      # optional; defaults to `input`
        offPeak:             # optional; used outside `peakWindows`
          input: 0.15
          output: 0.6
          cacheRead: 0.003
          cacheWrite: 0.15
    peakWindows:             # optional; defaults to DeepSeek's published windows
      - { startHourUtc: 1, endHourUtc: 4, weekdaysOnly: true }
      - { startHourUtc: 6, endHourUtc: 10, weekdaysOnly: true }
    balances:                # optional; provider route → wallet endpoint
      - provider: deepseek-official
        url: https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance
        credential: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY   # credential reference resolved in the Host
        auth: bearer                   # or x-api-key
        timeoutMs: 10000
    fees:                    # optional; Session events that are billed per request
      - event: web/deepseek-search-llm-request
        label: Search
        per1kRequests: 0.75  # DeepSeek Search/Fetch list price, USD
        currency: USD
```

Lookup specificity is `provider+model` → `provider+*` → `*+model` → `*+*`. A
route with no matching row still shows its token count, and the cost pill is
prefixed with "at least" while unpriced calls exist, so an estimate never
pretends to be complete.

A `fees` row counts the Session events of that exact type and bills them per
1,000 requests, outside token pricing, which is how DeepSeek bills its Search and
Fetch calls. The default row covers `web/deepseek-search-llm-request`, the event
the Web app's DeepSeek search feature records for each search request. Set
`fees: []` to price tokens only.

Shipped defaults are DeepSeek's published list prices for `deepseek-flash` and
`deepseek-v4-pro` (per 1M tokens, USD) with their peak/off-peak windows, and the
Search/Fetch per-request fee. Prices change; edit them in the profile patch.

## Balance

The Client reads the balance in two steps, and reports what it finds:

1. The signed-in DeepSeek account through `ctx.remote.account.getBalance`, for
   routes whose provider starts with `deepseek`.
2. This plugin's Host route, asked for the exact route the session is spending
   on. The Host matches that provider against `balances` (an exact provider wins
   over `*`), resolves the named credential through `ctx.credentials`, calls the
   endpoint, and answers with the wallet amounts only.

A route the Host prices no wallet for (`unsupported-provider`) shows nothing, so
the pill never appears for a provider that simply has no `balances` row. Every
other outcome is visible: the amount when the wallets are read, and `Balance —`
with the reason in its tooltip when the credential is missing, the endpoint
fails, or the route does not answer at all. That reason carries the HTTP status
and the body, which separates the two silent failures: a browser sees
`404 not found` when this build's route is not mounted, and `401 unauthorized`
when the request never reached it.

The key never reaches the browser, and the endpoint is ordinary configuration:
another provider whose API returns a wallet needs a new `balances` row plus a
parser kind in `index.js`. Amounts are re-read once a minute; each pill carries
its own currency, so a USD cost and a CNY balance never get conflated.

## How it is built

| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Two `sessionProjections` units — `costMeter` (prices provider-reported usage and per-request fees) and `costMeterFamily` (this session plus every session it delegated to) — plus one balance route on Connection's `/api` channel |
| Client | `client.js` | One `conversation.composer.dock` entry that renders the family wire value, falling back to the session value, asking the Host for a family read while the projection is still incomplete, and reading the balance |

The Host folds the durable Session log and publishes two client-visible
projections; the Client renders them through the `useProjection` slot prop. Both
halves were written against documented seams only:

- `ctx.sessionProjections.register({key, stateVersion, stateSchema, init, apply, wire})` —
  projection units; the registry calls only `schema.parse`, so the schemas here
  are small hand-written normalizers with no schema-library dependency.
- The `SessionEvent` envelope and payloads: `request/header` (route),
  `assistant/message` / `assistant/attempt` (usage, from `data.usage` or the
  last `usage` chunk of the com

plugins.description: Free, dependable web_search and web_fetch for DeepSeek Harness: fused keyless search plus optional Brave, SSRF-safe retrieval with reader escalation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reliable-web

Free, dependable `web_search` and `web_fetch` for DeepSeek Harness — no paid
search API, no required sign-up, no model-specific integration. It plugs into
the Harness web seam (`ctx.web`), so every model and every agent preset that can
call the shipped web tools gets free retrieval with the same tool schemas,
result cards, timeout policy, and error handling.

## Why this design

The Harness already owns the model-facing contract: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web`
defines the `web_search` / `web_fetch` tools, their argument validation, HTML→markdown
conversion, result presentation, and cancellation. This plugin deliberately does
**not** reimplement any of that. It registers two providers on the documented
extension point:

| Capability | Provider id | Registered with |
|---|---|---|
| search | `reliable` | `ctx.web.registerSearchProvider()` |
| fetch | `reliable` | `ctx.web.registerFetchProvider()` |

That choice is what keeps it working across Harness releases:

- no import of any `@deepseek-ai/*` package and no npm dependency, so a profile
  install works even when Harness internals are not resolvable;
- only the two documented seam methods, plus plain result objects matching the
  published shapes;
- provider errors use the documented open-string `code` vocabulary;
- `Config` is a Standard Schema (`~standard.validate`), which Cordis validates
  natively — no schema library to drift.

## Activation and provider selection

The shipped composition pins `web.searchProvider: deepseek-official` and
`web.fetchProvider: http`. A static patch that replaced those ids would leave a
dangling reference if this plugin is later disabled: every web call in the
profile would fail with `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING`.

Instead, the plugin **claims the selection at runtime**, only while the field
still holds an id it is explicitly allowed to replace (`takeOverSearchIds` /
`takeOverFetchIds`), and restores the previous value when it unloads. An id set
by `$DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` / `$DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROVIDER`, or any third-party
pin, is left untouched with a log line. Disabling the plugin therefore degrades
to the official provider instead of breaking search.

`takeOver: false` turns this off; then set the `web` row's provider ids to
`reliable` yourself.

## Search

A query fans out across free backends in waves of `searchFanout` concurrent
requests. Every default engine works without an account; several also use a key
when present to raise their limits, and Brave joins the chain only when a key is
configured.

| Engine | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `exa` | `EXA_API_KEY` optional | public Exa MCP tier; semantic index |
| `parallel` | `PARALLEL_API_KEY` optional | public Parallel search MCP tier |
| `brave` | `BRAVE_API_KEY` required | official API; free monthly credit (about 1,000 requests at list price) |
| `tavily` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` optional | keyless access mode |
| `keenable` | `KEENABLE_API_KEY` optional | public `/search/public` tier |
| `anysearch` | `ANYSEARCH_API_KEY` optional | keyless public endpoint |
| `firecrawl` | `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` optional | keyless monthly credit allowance |
| `duckduckgo` | — | independent HTML index, last-resort coverage |
| `wikipedia` | — | encyclopedic last resort |

### Brave (optional)

Brave is the one engine that is keyed by design: it is a strong independent
index and its prepaid plan includes a **free monthly credit** (currently $5,
which is about 1,000 requests at the $5/1,000 list price; some older plans show
a fixed monthly query allowance instead). The plugin reads the key from, in
order:

1. `braveApiKey` in the row config;
2. `BRAVE_API_KEY` (or `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY`) in the process environment;
3. `$DSH_HOME/secrets/brave.key`, then `~/.dsh/secrets/brave.key`,
   then `~/.config/dsh-reliable-web/brave.key`.

Only the first non-empty line of the file is used, so a trailing newline is
fine. Keep the file at mode `600`. When no key is found, the engine is skipped
with a debug line and the keyless chain is unchanged. Brave's per-second limit
depends on the plan (the free tier is typically one request per second), so the
plugin spaces Brave requests about 1.1s apart; a single query is not delayed,
and a multi-query `web_search` call queues instead of tripping a 429.

**Never commit the key.** The repository ignores `.env*`, `.secrets/`, and
`*.key`; the recommended locations are outside it.

Quality comes from **fusion**, not from picking a favorite engine:

- each engine's per-result contribution is `weight / (k + rank)`, so a document
  several independent indexes rank highly outranks one that only a single index
  ranks first (reciprocal rank fusion);
- URLs are canonicalized for dedupe — fragments and tracking parameters folded
  out of the key, `www.` and scheme folded, trailing slashes folded, GitHub blob
  URLs collapsed across branch/commit refs; the displayed URL keeps its fragment
  but drops tracking parameters;
- snippets and titles come from the most authoritative engine that returned the
  document, with gaps filled by the others.

Reliability is separate from quality:

- a failed, throttled, or empty engine is cooled down (rate limits 60s, quota
  and auth 30min, transient 15s) and the chain continues;
- every engine shares one wall-clock budget (`searchBudgetMs`);
- a short TTL cache (5 min, 256 entries, LRU) serves repeated queries without
  touching any upstream, which matters on per-address free tiers;
- `truncated` is honest: it means sources were actually dropped, not merely that
  the requested count was reached.

If every non-cooling engine fails, the call throws a structured
`WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` rather than pretending the web has no results. If engines
answer with nothing, it returns an empty successful result.

## Fetch

Retrieval escalates only when it must:

1. **direct**, SSRF-safe HTTP(S). No third party sees the URL. HTML is returned
   as `kind: 'html'` so the Harness's own converter produces the model-facing
   markdown. This is the fast path for ordinary pages.
2. **readers** (`jina`, `exa`, `firecrawl`), launched concurrently, only when
   direct was refused (401/403/406/429/451/503), is a bot challenge, is a
   client-rendered shell, or failed at the transport level. They render the page
   on their own infrastructure and return markdown, which recovers pages direct
   retrieval cannot see.
3. a definitive direct status such as `404`/`410` is returned as a result
   immediately — a reader would only repeat it slower.

A readable success always beats a bot wall or an error page. A `404` is a
result, not an exception. One deadline (`fetchBudgetMs`, 25s) covers the whole
chain, leaving headroom under the tool's 30s cooperative budget so a timeout is
reported precisely instead of as an opaque `TOOL_TIMEOUT`.

### SSRF and resource safety

The transport is self-contained and fails closed:

- only `http:`/`https:`, no embedded credentials, 2048-character URL limit;
- every hop is re-parsed, re-screened, and re-pinned, so redirects cannot
  escape the public-address policy;
- every resolved address must be public; loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT,
  benchmark, multicast, documentation, and reserved ranges are refused, for
  literals and resolved names alike;
- the connection is pinned to the validated address set, so a DNS answer cannot
  change between check and connect;
- response bytes, redirect hops, and converted characters are capped;
- decompression is bounded, so a compressed body cannot expand without limit.

`allowPrivateNetwork: true` exists for a local/intranet deployment and is off by
default; it is the one setting that lets a model reach cloud metadata and local
services.

## Configuration

The row is `reliable-web`. Every field is optional.

```yaml
- id: reliable-web
  name: 'dsh-reliable-web'
  config:
    # search
    engineOrder: ['exa', 'parallel', 'brave', 'tavily', 'keenable', 'anysearch', 'firecrawl', 'duckduckgo', 'wikipedia']
    disabledEngines: []
    searchBudgetMs: 25000
    searchFanout: 3
    searchTimeoutMs: 12000
    searchCacheTtlMs: 300000      # 0 disables the cache
    braveApiKey: ''               # prefer BRAVE_API_KE

plugins.description: Delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar straight into a Trash settings page, then restore them or delete them permanently.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-trash

Delete sessions from the sidebar into a **Trash** page in Settings, then
restore them or delete them permanently.

A global [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
plugin published as one npm package carrying both halves: a Host plugin mounted
by the bundle patch, and a browser half served from the same package's `./client`
export.

## Install

This package is a DeepSeek Harness **bundle**: `dsh.bundle.patch` is its Host
row, `dsh.client` is its browser half, and the package resolves both. Install it
into a profile with the harness's own Plugin Manager — point it at this
directory (or at the repository URL) and it records the bundle in the profile:

- `dsh` CLI, if the harness exposes the Plugin Manager surface:
  `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <source>`
- or add it to the profile's dependencies and bundle list directly, then boot.

The profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` is applied *after* this bundle's layer, so
it is also where any config below is pinned.

## What it adds

- A delete button at the end of every Session row in the sidebar, beside the
  shipped archive and pin buttons. **One press deletes**: the session goes
  straight to Trash with no confirmation step, because Trash is the undo.
- A **Delete session** row in the Session's `…` menu, for keyboard users and
  anyone who never hovers a row.
- A **Trash** page in Settings listing every deleted session, with
  **Restore** and **Delete permanently** per session and **Empty Trash** for
  the whole list. Permanently deleting a session drops its log and its derived
  projection cache; a live session cannot be trashed or purged. These two stay
  behind a confirmation, because they are the irreversible half.

### The deleted row leaves an open browser immediately

Moving a log aside makes the session absent from the Host catalog on the next
listing — but nothing schedules one. The browser's session store was filled by a
pull that already happened, so a deleted row would otherwise stay on screen (the
sidebar renders it as an ungrouped "stray") until the page was reloaded.

After the log actually moves, the Host therefore emits the declared Remote Event
`api-session/removed`, which Cordis relays to every connected client. That is the
same path the shipped Session controller uses for its own disposal
notifications (`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js`), so the browser clears
the row through its ordinary list-mutation code — no client-side list surgery,
and no plugin knowledge of another package's internals. The route's response
reports `announced: false` if the relay was unavailable, so a deployment without
the event simply falls back to clearing on the next load.

## How deletion works

The Harness ships no session-deletion API: `SessionPersistence` creates, opens,
lists, and flushes handles but never removes one, and the browser session
controller exposes no delete verb. What the store does publish is its
addressing rule — a session is visible exactly when its directory holds a
canonical generation log (`session.jsonl`, `session.v<N>.jsonl`, either with the
configured compression suffix).

So deleting a session appends `.trashed` to that one basename inside the
session's own directory. Nothing is copied and the log's bytes are untouched:
`stat`/`list`/`open` all report the session as absent, so the sidebar catalog,
search, title folding, and lineage traces treat it as gone without knowing this
plugin exists. Restoring removes the suffix again, which brings the title back
with the log, and permanently deleting removes the directory and the session's
projection-cache record.

The trash index is this plugin's own plain JSON document. A missing, empty, or
hand-edited index is reconciled against the session root on every read, so a
trashed session is never stranded by index damage.

## Configuration

The row takes an optional `config`, set from the profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` (the layer applied after this bundle's):

```yaml
- id: session-trash
  name: 'dsh-session-trash'
  config:
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/sessions, the session-persistence root.
    sessionsRoot: /absolute/path/to/sessions
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-session-trash/index.json.
    indexFile: /absolute/path/to/index.json
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions.
    projectionCacheDir: /absolute/path/to/session_projcache/sessions
```

## Verification

Two dependency-free suites ship with the package and run against a scratch
session root in the system temporary directory:

```sh
node verify.mjs        # the store: trash, list, restore, purge, empty, recovery
node verify-route.mjs  # the route: dispatch, validation, refusals, envelopes
```

`verify.mjs` asserts the property this design rests on — a trashed session is
invisible to a canonical-generation scan while its bytes are byte-for-byte
unchanged, and restoring brings back the identical file.

## Upgrade stability

The Host half imports no Harness package; its one contribution is a
`connection.fetch` exact route on the authenticated `/api` channel, and the
store knowledge it relies on is the filename grammar above — a storage-format
constant rather than a module API, with `v<N>` left open-ended so a future
format generation is matched by the same scan. The browser half imports no
Harness Client package either: it uses the module-loader factory contract,
`ctx.slots.inject`/`register`, the slot's standard `useSessions` hook,
`ctx.locale`, and `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens only.

# dsh-control-center

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Three visual Settings pages for the DeepSeek Harness: **MCP servers**, **skills**
and **global personas**. One dual-face plugin — a host half that owns the data
and the one model-facing contribution, and a browser half that renders the
pages into the settings shell.

> The Chinese document ([README.zh.md](README.zh.md)) is the fuller one: it adds
> the verification log, troubleshooting, and the one-click script reference.

```
Settings
├── …
├── MCP 管理          MCP server CRUD
├── Skill 管理        author or pull skills, inspect and delete them
└── 全局人设          a library of persona documents, one active
```

## Install

The package is a normal DSH bundle. Any channel works.

**One script (Windows).** Copies the package, backs the patch up once, and
writes the marked mount block — idempotent, `-DryRun` to preview, `-Profile` /
`-DshHome` to target another profile:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\uninstall.ps1   # one-key restore
```

**Official CLI**, which also records the bundle in the profile manifest:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-control-center
```

**By hand**, for a profile whose `node_modules` is managed manually: copy this
directory to `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-control-center`, then append the mount
row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: control-center
      name: 'dsh-control-center'
```

`dsh-hmr` watches that file, so the plugin activates on save; the browser half
is part of the client boot graph and needs one page refresh the first time it
appears. After the first installation the script leaves
`cordis.patch.yml.bak-dsh-control-center` as the final rollback point.

## The three pages

### MCP 管理

An MCP server is a Loader row, not a settings value, so the page writes a
delimited **managed block** into the active profile's own patch layer and lets
`dsh-hmr` reload the composition:

```yaml
# >>> dsh-control-center:mcp — managed, edit it from Settings instead
- insert: [{"id":"cc-mcp-github","name":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client","config":{…}}]
# <<< dsh-control-center:mcp
```

Everything outside the two markers is preserved byte for byte, and the payload
is JSON — a strict subset of YAML 1.2 — so no URL, argument or environment value
can change the document's shape. The definitions live in
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/mcp-servers.json`; the block is regenerated from them
on every write, so disabling a server removes its row without losing it.

The row reports its live Loader state, so the list distinguishes *configured*,
*enabled* and *connected*.

### Skill 管理

Skills are ordinary files, so this page is a filesystem editor over the roots
`dsh-skill-filesystem` already scans — it keeps no database:

| Root | Source |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/skills` | `user-dsh`, provider rank 400 — where installs go |
| `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` | `user-agents`, rank 500 |
| any `customSkillDirs` | from a live `skill-filesystem` row |

Project roots (`.dsh/skills`, `.agents/skills`) depend on the session's working
directory rather than on this global page and are deliberately left out.

* **New skill** writes `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` with `name`, `description`,
  `whenToUse` and the body.
* **Raw editor** opens the current file verbatim; saving re-validates the
  frontmatter.
* **Pull from GitHub** downloads one source archive, finds every `SKILL.md` at a
  plausible depth, and installs each bundle. Three URL shapes are accepted, plus
  the `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` spelling:

  ```
  https://github.com/owner/repo
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>/<subpath>
  ```

  No `git` binary is needed: the archive is fetched from `codeload` and unpacked
  by a small built-in tar reader. An existing skill is only replaced when
  **overwrite** is on.

The filesystem provider watches its roots, so a created, edited or deleted skill
reaches the next model step without a restart.

### 全局人设

Each persona is a Markdown document under
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/personas/`, with its name and description in
`personas.json`. Exactly one is active, and the page can clear the seat.

The active document is registered as **one** system-prompt section:

```js
ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: 'control-center:persona',
  order: 5,
  text: activeDocument,
  interpolate: false,
})
```

Three properties follow, and all are intended:

* **additive** — the harness identity, the deployment persona, tool guidance and
  the environment suffix are untouched; the section lands immediately after the
  deployment persona prefix at order 0;
* **global** — a preset that shadows `deployment:persona-prefix` for one agent
  does not remove it, so every session is covered;
* **literal** — `interpolate: false` keeps `{{…}}` as written, so a stray brace
  in prose can never fail prompt assembly.

Switching the active document disposes and re-registers the section; the next
assembly carries the new text.

## HTTP API

One POST-only route, `/control-center/api`, with a `method` field:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `system.info` | paths and version |
| `mcp.state` / `mcp.save` / `mcp.remove` / `mcp.toggle` | MCP servers |
| `skill.state` / `skill.read` / `skill.save` / `skill.write` / `skill.remove` / `skill.pull` | skills |
| `persona.state` / `persona.read` / `persona.save` / `persona.remove` / `persona.activate` | personas |

Responses are `{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`.
The route is fenced against cross-origin browser callers: an `Origin` header must
name a loopback host, and a present `Content-Type` must be JSON. A caller with no
`Origin` — the Electron IPC bridge, a shell tool — is already running with the
user's own authority.

## Checks

Both scripts need no dependencies and no harness:

```bash
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs     # host half: frontmatter, tar, the managed block, all three stores over real files
node scripts/clientsmoke.mjs   # browser half: bundle, slot registration, every section rendered with stubbed host replies
```

`skill.pull`'s network path is not exercised by either; verify it against a real
repository from the running harness.

## Layout

```
index.js                 host half: route, API table, persona section, MCP reconciliation
client.js                browser half: the three Settings sections
lib/wire.js              body reader, JSON responder, request fence
lib/paths.js             DSH_HOME / profile locations, atomic read-write
lib/mcp.js               MCP store + the managed patch block
lib/skills.js            skill roots, frontmatter, CRUD, GitHub install
lib/github.js            repository reference parsing + archive download
lib/tar.js               minimal tar reader
lib/personas.js          persona store + the prompt section lifecycle
scripts/install.ps1      one-key install (UTF-8 with BOM — see README.zh.md)
scripts/uninstall.ps1    one-key restore
scripts/selfcheck.mjs    host-half checks
scripts/clientsmoke.mjs  browser-half checks
```

## Publishing to the DSH plugin market

`package.json` is already shaped for it (no `private`, `license`, `repository`
with `directory`, `keywords`, `engines.dsh`, `peerDependencies`,
`dsh.manifestVersion`) and `locale/{en,zh}.json` supplies the store card copy.

The catalog is the curated list [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin):
add ONE file under `data/plugins/`, run `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs`, open
a PR. The step-by-step checklist — plus the entry YAML, a pre-flight validator
and the screenshot template — lives in the repository's `publish/` directory.

plugins.description: Due-diligence document review for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic engine (documents → rule packs → risk report), evidence chain, docx/xlsx reports
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dd-forge — due-diligence document review (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

**Documents → rule packs → risk report**: feed the deterministic engine a due-diligence folder (registry / equity / financials / contracts / charters / employment contracts) and get a sourced risk report. Built for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/DeepSeek-AI/deepseek-harness); the engine (opcore) itself has zero dsh dependencies and runs standalone.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh session (model + judgement)                  │
│   skills: dsh-dd-forge-review / -report          │  ← judgement layer (prompt skills)
│   tools:  dd_review / dd_rules                   │  ← deterministic layer (registered tools)
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ opcore engine (engine/, zero dsh deps)           │
│   loader (docs → facts) → rule execution → report │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ packs/ (YAML rule packs — data, not code)        │
│   general-company 12 · contract-basics 8         │
│   trade-contract 8 · trade-bulk 10               │
│   logistics 8 · labour 8 · credit-financials 8   │
│   guarantee 5 · corporate-charter 5              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-dd-forge
```

Local development: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-dd-forge` — pnpm `link:` installs do not auto-install dependencies, so run `npm install` in this directory first.

## Use

In a dsh session, hand a target folder to the model ("run a due-diligence review on ./target-company"), or call the tools directly:

- **`dd_review`** — run all rule packs over a folder (the `packs` parameter optionally narrows to a pack subset); returns findings and writes the report into the workspace (`reportPath` overrides the report location); the `format` parameter selects `md` / `docx` / `xlsx` (comma-separated, default `md`); the top-up loop parameters are `saveRun` (serialize this run into a re-runnable review.json snapshot) and `baseline` (diff against a previous snapshot — see "Top-up re-run loop"); pass a `targets` array to review several folders in one call (see "Batch review")
- **`dd_rules`** — list packs and every rule with severity, category, and public reference

Skills: `dsh-dd-forge-review` (folder conventions + verification discipline for high findings), `dsh-dd-forge-report` (writing the full DD report on top of engine output).

### Batch review (several folders)

To review several subjects in one session, `dd_review` takes a `targets` array (mutually exclusive with `target`): `targets=["./companyA","./companyB"]`. Each folder gets its own report set (exported per `format` as `<workspace>/dd-review-report-<company>.<ext>`; the folder name when no registry document names the subject; duplicates get `-2`/`-3` suffixes), plus one **summary index** at `<workspace>/dd-review-index.md` (`indexPath` overrides the location): a per-subject conclusion/stats table, a cross-subject high-severity quick view, totals, and relative links to every report — closed by the same disclaimer.

Every folder is validated up front (one inaccessible folder fails the whole call — no half delivery). `reportPath` / `saveRun` / `baseline` are single-run parameters and are rejected with `targets` — to take one folder through the top-up loop, call the tool with `target` for it alone.

### Folder conventions

The engine recognizes documents by filename patterns; anything missing simply leaves the corresponding rules as `missing_data`:

| Document | File | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registry | `工商信息.json` (or any json matching 工商/registry) | Chinese or English keys; capital in 万元 |
| Equity | `*股权*.csv` or `.xlsx` (filename/sheet matching 股权/股东) | header: 股东,认缴出资(万元),实缴出资(万元),持股比例(%),备注 |
| Financials | `*资产负债*.csv`, `*利润*.csv`, `*现金流量*.csv` (or same-named xlsx sheets) | accounts as rows, years as columns (`科目,2024,2023`), 万元 |
| Contracts | `contracts/*.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | one contract per file; optional frontmatter: 标题, 签订日期 |
| Charter | any `章程`-matching `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | extracts company name, registered capital, shareholder rows, mandatory items, share-transfer clause |
| Employment contract | any `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` whose filename contains 「劳动合同」 or whose body contains 「劳动合同期限」 | extracts contract term, probation months and its statutory tiered cap, probation/agreed salary, non-compete term and compensation, service period with training cost and penalty, mandatory items and rules-policy wording |

docx (contracts/charters) and xlsx (financials/equity) are parsed **natively** (mammoth/exceljs, lazily loaded — zero cost when absent). Only scans/images need in-session conversion first.

The loader also extracts clause facts from contract bodies for the specialized packs: **deposit amount and ratio** ("定金…N 元"), **advance amount and ratio** (amount form "预付款 N 元" or percent form "预付 N%", feeding the bulk-trade pack), **payment term days** ("N 日内付清/支付" — deadlines that pay a deposit/advance do not count; read by both the trade and logistics packs), **daily penalty rate** ("万分之X/日", auto-annualized), **trade-contract classification** (购销/买卖/采购/销售/供货/大宗商品/贸易 — bulk-trade rules report 不适用 on non-trade contracts), **logistics-contract classification** (货物运输/运输服务/承运/仓储/配送 — logistics rules report 不适用 on non-logistics contracts; a counterparty *named* 「物流」 does not classify a contract), plus 36 clause-presence probes (risk transfer, force majeure, notice, acceptance, exclusivity, third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-vs-penalty election, documents of title, auto-renewal, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related & dispute institution, cargo damage liability, insured/declared-value carriage, loading duties, subcontracting restrictions, POD & reconciliation, cargo claims, vehicle & driver qualifications, …).

Employment contracts are parsed as their own document type (they never enter the commercial-contract candidate set): **contract term in years** (date form 「劳动合同期限自 X 起至 Y 止」 first, stated years as fallback; open-ended contracts detected separately), **probation months with the statutory tiered cap** (Labour Contract Law art. 19 tiers: <3 months 0 / 3 months-1 year 1 / 1-3 years 2 / ≥3 years & open-ended 6), **probation vs agreed salary** (auto-derived 80%-line ratio), **non-compete term** (months/years normalized) **and compensation clause** (an explicit 「无需支付经济补偿」 waiver does not count as agreed), **service period with training cost and penalty**, plus art.-17 mandatory-item and rules-policy probes.

## Rule packs

Nine packs, 72 rules, each with a public reference (statute or an explicitly labelled convention threshold):

| Pack | Rules | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `general-company` | 12 | registry status, paid-in ratio, equity cross-checks, balance-sheet identity & solvency, guarantee resolutions |
| `contract-basics` | 8 | essential clauses, digit-vs-uppercase amounts, signing date and signature block |
| `trade-contract` | 8 | deposit cap (Civ. Code art. 586, 20%), payment term (90-day convention), risk transfer, force majeure, daily penalty annualized |
| `trade-bulk` | 10 | bulk-trade special: advance ratio (30% convention), third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-plus-penalty election (Civ. Code art. 588), force majeure excluding market swings, documents of title (仓单/提单), auto-renewal exit, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related dispute institution |
| `logistics` | 8 | logistics special: cargo damage/loss liability (Civ. Code art. 832), insured/declared-value carriage, freight payment term (60-day convention reading the same fact as TC-002's 90-day line — layered thresholds), loading duties, subcontracting restrictions (cf. art. 923), POD & reconciliation, cargo-claim procedure & deadline, vehicle & driver qualifications |
| `labour` | 8 | employment special: mandatory clauses (Labour Contract Law art. 17), probation tiered cap and 80% salary line (arts. 19/20), non-compete compensation and two-year cap (arts. 23/24), servi

# 🐱 anime-pet-widget — DSH 二次元宠物陪伴插件

> 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面 **右下角** 的小宠物「小窝兽」。
> 它会**根据 Agent 状态做出不同反应**，并用 Web Audio **实时合成声音**——
> 当任务完成时，它会高高兴兴地唱出一段完成琶音。🎉

这是一个类型为 **动态 Cordis 插件（Dynamic Cordis Plugin）** 的项目：它临时挂载到当前 DSH 进程，
不修改任何仓库源码或配置，卸载时自动清理所有副作用。仓库中的 `host.js` 与 `client.js`
即插件的两半（Host 半 + Client 半），可直接交给 DSH 的 `cordis_define` 工具加载。

---

## ✨ 功能特性

| 特性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 📌 右下角常驻 | 挂在 `shell.overlay` 全局浮层，`position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 20px`，位于所有栏位之上 |
| 🐾 可爱形象 | 粉色渐变胶囊里一只小猫 🐱，带呼吸 / 工作跳动 / 庆祝 / 难过的 CSS 动画 |
| 💬 状态气泡 | 实时显示当前状态文案（等主人 / 努力工作中 / 完成啦 / 出错了） |
| 🔊 不同声音 | 根据 Agent 状态切换：**开始音**、**完成音**、**出错音** |
| 🎵 实时合成 | 用 Web Audio（`AudioContext` + 振荡器）现场合成三个音效，**无需任何音频文件**、无网络请求 |
| ✅ 任务完成提示 | 监听 `idle ⇄ running` 切换，在 `running → idle` 时播放"完成任务"的 do-mi-sol-do 琶音 |
| 🔇 一键静音 | 胶囊上的 🔊 / 🔇 按钮可随时开关声音 |
| 🧹 自动清理 | 所有监听 / 处理器 / 定时器 / 样式均归属当前 Cordis Fiber，停止或更新插件时一并移除 |

---

## 🔧 工作原理

### 架构总览

```
                ┌───────────────────────────  DSH 主机进程  ───────────────────────────────┐
                │  host.js (Host 半)                                                       │
                │                                                                            │
                │   ctx.on('agent/status')  ─── idle ⇄ running ──┐                          │
                │   ctx.on('agent/error')   ─── errored ────────┤                          │
                │                                                ▼                          │
                │                                     { status, errored } ← 纯标量快照      │
                │                                                │                          │
                │                 harness.handle('anime-pet:status')  ◀───── 轮询           │
                └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                            ▲  host.call (JSON RPC, Client→Host)
                                            │
                ┌───────────────────────────  浏览器页面  ───────────────────────────────────┐
                │  client.js (Client 半)                                                    │
                │                                                                            │
                │   styles.insert(css)  ───── 注入样式                                       │
                │   slots.register('shell.overlay', id:'anime-pet')  ── 右下角渲染            │
                │   AudioFX 合成器  ──── 开始/完成/出错 三音效                              │
                └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 用到的 DSH 能力（全部通过 Inspect Provider 查询确认）

- **Host 事件** `agent/status`：Agent 状态变化 `idle ⇄ running`——这是触发"开始工作"与"任务完成"声的关键。
- **Host 事件** `agent/error`：某一步或某轮出错——宠物据此播放"抱歉"音并显示 😿。
- **Host Builtin** `harness.handle`：注册插件私有的 JSON 处理器，供 Client 侧 `host.call` 调用。
- **Client Slot** `shell.overlay`：全窗口浮层（frame-wide，位于所有柱 / 滚动容器之外，默认点击穿透、由条目自行开启 pointer-events）。
- **Client Service** `timer`：`ctx.interval`（每 650ms 轮询状态）与 `ctx.timeout`（完成/出错后延时恢复）。
- **Client Builtin** `styles.insert` / `host.call` / `React`：注入样式、调用 Host、构建 UI。

### 状态机

| Agent 状态 | 宠物表现 | 音效 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | 小猫 🐱 缓慢呼吸，"主人，我在等你哦～" | 无 |
| `running` | 上下跳动，"努力工作中！加油！" | 开始音（柔和的上升“咕”音） |
| `running → idle`（任务完成） | 庆祝动画 🎉，"完成啦！🎉" | **完成音**（do-mi-sol-do 琶音） |
| 出错 | 😿 晃动，"唔…刚刚出错了…" | 偏低沉的"抱歉"音 |

> 说明：浏览器默认禁止在用户与页面交互前自动播放声音。插件在页面**第一次 `pointerdown`** 时
> 调用 `AudioContext.resume()` 解锁音频——所以在页面里随便点一下，声音即可正常响起。

---

## 📦 安装与运行（在 DSH 中加载）

本插件是**运行时动态插件**，无需全局安装或改动仓库：

1. 打开 DSH Web 界面，进入一个会话。
2. 让 Agent 调用 `cordis_define` 工具，并传入 `dist/cordis-package.json` 的内容（可由下方脚本生成）。
3. 用 `cordis_run` 激活该 Package（`mode: "run"`），Client 半会弹出**授权请求**——点击"允许/批准"。
4. 刷新或直接观察页面右下角，小窝兽就会出现。

### 一键生成 `dist/cordis-package.json`

```bash
node scripts/build-package.mjs
```

该脚本读取 `host.js` + `client.js`，输出可直接粘贴进 `cordis_define` 的 JSON。

### 手动加载（示意）

`cordis_define` 的 `code.host` 与 `code.client` 分别是两个**普通 JavaScript 函数体**（非 TS / 非 JSX）：

- `code.host` ← 取自 `host.js` 的 `return { apply(ctx) { … } }`
- `code.client` ← 取自 `client.js` 的 `return { inject, apply(ctx) { … } }`

两个半区各自在对应平台运行，并共享同一个 `pluginId` / `packageId`。

---

## 🎛️ 使用说明

- **静音 / 开启声音**：点击胶囊上的 🔊 或 🔇。
- **解锁声音**：任何一次页面点击即可（自动播放策略所致）。
- **更换宠物名**：编辑器里改 `AnimePet` 组件中的 `'小窝兽'`。
- **更换形象**：改 `.pet-face` 里的 emoji（见"自定义"）。

---

## 🎨 自定义

### 改形象（emoji）

在 `client.js` 的 `AnimePet` 组件中修改 `face`：

```js
const face =
  phase === 'done'
    ? status === 'running' ? '✨' : '🎉'
    : phase === 'error' ? '😿' : '🐱';   // ← 把 🐱 换成 🐰 / 🐹 / 🦊 / 🐶 …
```

### 改配色 / 动画

颜色在 `PET_CSS` 中：

```css
.pet-body {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd6e7, #d6e4ff);  /* ← 胶囊渐变 */
}
.pet-bubble { border: 2px solid #ffd6e7; }               /* ← 气泡边框 */
```

### 改声音（Web Audio 音高 / 旋律 / 强弱）

所有合成都集中在 `AudioFX`，例如完成音是五音上行琶音：

```js
complete: () => {
  tone(523.25, 0,    0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // do
  tone(659.25, 0.14, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // mi
  tone(783.99, 0.28, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // sol
  tone(1046.5, 0.42, 0.34, 'triangle', 0.2);   // do' (高)
  tone(1318.5, 0.48, 0.3,  'sine',     0.1);   // 亮泛音
}
```

---

## 📁 目录结构

```
anime-pet-widget/
├─ host.js                     # Host 半：监听 Agent 状态，提供 RPC（status/errored）
├─ client.js                   # Client 半：右下角渲染 + Web Audio 合成 + 状态轮询
├─ scripts/
│  └─ build-package.mjs        # 读取 host.js/client.js → 输出 cordis_define 载荷
├─ package.json                # 项目元数据（DSH 插件，非 npm 发布包）
├─ LICENSE                     # MIT
├─ .gitignore
└─ README.md
```

---

## 🔬 技术细节

- **没有音频文件、没有网络请求**：三个音效全部由 `AudioContext` 的 `OscillatorNode` + `GainNode` 实时合成，体积最小、最可控。
- **JSON 边界严格**：Host 与 Client 只通过 `host.call` 传递 `{ status: 'idle'|'running', errored: boolean }` 这类纯标量，绝不序列化任何 Service / Session / Agent 存活对象。
- **副作用可逆**：`ctx.on`、`harness.handle`、`ctx.interval`、`ctx.timeout`、`styles.insert` 全部由当前 Fiber 持有；`cordis_stop` / `cordis_update` / `cordis_undefine` 会一次性清理。
- **仅使用纯 JS**：两端都不使用 TS / JSX / import；UI 用 `React.createElement` 构建。
- **轮询而非长连接**：Client 每 650ms 调用一次 `host.call('anime-pet:status')`，足以捕捉空闲↔运行切换，成本极低。

---

## ⚠️ 兼容性与注意事项

- 依赖 **DSH 动态 Cordis 插件运行时**（`cordis_define` / `cordis_run` 工具）。若你的 Harness 版本没有这些工具，本插件无法加载。
- 声音需要**浏览器支持 Web Audio**（现代 Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari 均可）。
- 自动播放依赖用户与页面的一次交互；若完全无人操作页面则不会出声（动画与文案不受影响）。

---

## 📄 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)

---

## 🙏 关于

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）开发的一个小玩具，欢迎 fork / 改造成你自己的专属宠物。
如果你给它加了可爱的新形象或好听的音效，欢迎提 PR 分享～ 🐾

---

## 🇬🇧 English

**anime-pet-widget** is a Dynamic Cordis Plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It renders a kawaii pet pinned to the **bottom-right** of the web GUI and reacts to the Agent state with **synthesized sounds** (Web Audio, no assets needed). When a task finishes (`running → idle`), the pet plays a cheerful completion arpeggio.

**How to load:** hand `dist/cordis-package.json` (from `node scripts/build-package.mjs`) to the DSH `cordis_define` tool, then `cordis_run` it and approve the Client authorization.

**Files:** `host.js` (Host half — listens to `agent/status` / `agent/error`, serves `{ status, errored }` over `harness.handle`), `client.js` (Client half — mounts in the `shell.overlay` slot, polls every 650 ms via `host.call`, and synthesizes start/complete/error sounds). License: MIT.

# django-generic-websocket-project
a generic websocket  
一个非常通用的websocket项目  

# Install
```bash
# 默认使用内存 channel layer，不需要 redis server
git clone git@github.com:ramwin/django-generic-websocket-project.git
cd django-generic-websocket-project
pip3 install -r ./requirements.txt
```

# channel layer（默认不需要 redis）
默认 `CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=memory`（见 `.env.shared`），消息在**当前进程内**广播：
不需要 redis 服务，也不需要 `channels_redis`，`python3 manage.py runserver 7420` 直接就能跑。

多实例部署（`deploy/supervisor.conf` 的 3 个 daphne、docker compose 扩副本）**必须**换成 redis，
否则实例 A 推送的消息，连在实例 B 上的客户端收不到：
```bash
# .env 或 .env.shared（.env 优先级更高）
CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=redis
WEBSOCKET_REDIS_HOST=localhost
WEBSOCKET_REDIS_PORT=6379
```
```bash
pip3 install channels_redis   # 需要同时安装这个包
```
其他说明：
- 启动了 memory 后端时，服务启动日志里会有一条 WARNING 提醒单进程限制
- 配置值只能是 `memory` 或 `redis`，写错了启动时会直接报 `ImproperlyConfigured`
- 项目里 `.env` / `.env.shared` 的优先级**高于**进程环境变量，Docker 的 `environment` 覆盖不生效

# Usage
```
# in terminal 1
python3 manage.py runserver 7420

# in terminal 2
python3 test_send_message.py

# in terminal 3
python3 test_receive_message.py
```

# 浏览器里查看会话
```bash
# 终端 1：启动服务
python3 manage.py runserver 7420

# 浏览器打开（房间名跟推送时用的房间名保持一致）
# http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/room/room_123/

# 终端 2：用 HTTP 接口往这个房间推消息，页面上会立刻出现
curl -X POST http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/send-message/room_123/ \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{"message": "hello"}'
```
- 页面里的输入框也可以发消息，会通过 WebSocket 广播给房间内的所有客户端
- 消息格式不限：有 `message` 字段就显示这个文本，其余字段以 JSON 附在下面；没有 `message` 字段就整体格式化输出
- 需要鉴权时把 token 放在页面地址上，会透传给 WebSocket：`http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/room/room_123/?token=token123`
- 房间名只能包含字母/数字/下划线（和 WebSocket 路由 `(?P<room_name>\w+)` 一致）
- 连接断开（比如服务重启）后页面会指数退避自动重连
- 页面模板：`generic/templates/generic/room.html`，HTML 和 JS 全部内联，不依赖静态文件服务

# Deploy
1. change `project/settings.py`
```
DEBUG = False
ALLOWED_HOSTS = [<your hostname>]
```

2. run command
```
replace example.com with your hostname
daphne -b <example.com> -p <port> wsbackend.asgi:application
```

# load balance
1. use `deploy/supervisor.conf` to run multi instance
2. use `deploy/nginx/websocket.ramwin.com` to loadbalance
3. 多实例必须设置 `CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=redis` 并安装 `channels_redis`，否则跨实例收不到消息
